_paths_comment: Portable paths: ${HOUFIN_DATA}/${HOUFIN_PROCESSED} expand at load (src/config_utils.py; default <repo>/data and <repo>/data/processed locally, override via env on HPC). NOTE: the age-model fit + path-features pipeline is a later milestone; these paths are provisional (they consume the encoder cube + BBS produced upstream).
_disease_arrival_map_comment: Per-pixel first-affected-breeding-season for House Finch mycoplasmal conjunctivitis, on the model grid. Built by scripts/build_disease_arrival_map.py from the documented 1994-2006 spread history (there is no published raster). Consumed by model_inputs.py as the onset gate for the K depression -- see src/model/age_fields.py.

kernel_contract._comment: The encoder supplies an uncentered 64-D Nyström feature map; model ingestion explicitly retains the first latent_dim=16 eigenfeatures by default to fit VRAM. Conditional on each w_scale, iid coefficients over those retained features imply Cov[H(x),H(x')|w_scale] = w_scale^2 Z_r(x)·Z_r(x'), the configured rank-r approximation to the original Ružička kernel. Truncation must be config-driven and recorded, never silent.

dispersal._comment: Single source of truth shared by Z_disp preparation and the forward model; resolved in exactly one place, build_kernels.dispersal_spec. Do not duplicate these boundaries in code.
dispersal._radial_splits_comment: juvenile_radial_splits_km accepts either an explicit list of km boundaries (must start at 0.0 and end >=1e8) or the string "derive", which computes equal-mass radial bands (quantiles, default terciles, overridable via juvenile_radial_split_quantiles) for whatever juvenile_mdd_km is set. The pinned list below is NOT a set of quantiles of the 330 km kernel: it is log-spaced band edges from 50 to 1500 km, produced by a get_log_spaced_splits(50,1500,3) helper that no longer exists, and it does NOT move with juvenile_mdd_km -- at mdd=150 the three cohorts hold 67/28/4% of the dispersal mass, at 400 they hold 32/41/27%. It is retained here only for artifact compatibility: the 124-year Z_disp cube on TACC was built under these exact literals, and ingest compares the resolved dispersal dict for exact equality. New work (and every dispersal sweep point) should use "derive".
dispersal._path_comment: Z_disp is intentionally a land-conditioned neighborhood/path summary: at each fractional displacement, water/nodata is excluded and the remaining land contribution is normalized. It is not a literal trajectory hazard through water.

age_structure_prior._comment: Resolution-invariant weak local-age-structure regularizer. We average log Beta density over land cell-years, then multiply by effective_sites, instead of treating every grid cell/year as an independent prior observation. This is a distributional belief about a representative local cell, not a prior on the domain-wide mean.

population_model._comment: Mechanistic/data-scale constants persisted into model-input metadata; no hidden grid or invasion constants in ingestion code.
population_model._disease_prior_comment: The mycoplasmal-conjunctivitis effect on carrying capacity, as a STRUCTURED hypothesis: K = K_base * (1 - severity(x) * onset_gate(x,t) * (1 - recovery(t - arrival))). See src/model/age_fields.py for the formulation and src/model/age_priors.py for the priors. This replaces a generic 967-coefficient spatiotemporal cosine field (the old st_basis_space/time_frequencies) which was subtracted from K's PRE-softplus argument. That design failed two ways: (1) fitted K sits where softplus is effectively exp(), so an additive penalty was an unbounded MULTIPLICATIVE one -- a depression of 3.5 removed 97% of K -- and it annihilated carrying capacity across the entire eastern US rather than rescaling it; (2) being the model's only non-covariate spatial degree of freedom, with K ~multiplicative on predicted abundance, it absorbed every kind of spatial misfit rather than disease alone. The structured form is bounded by construction (a fraction in (0,1) can never zero K out), uses ~55 free parameters instead of 967, and every parameter states a testable claim. Frequencies are per-AXIS over the grid extent: severity/lag space=4 -> ~900km half-wavelength N-S, ~1500km E-W, i.e. deliberately coarse regional structure (east vs west vs plains), not habitat-scale detail.

disease_prior._mu_comment: Logit of the PEAK fraction of K removed once the front has passed. mu_loc=0 -> prior median 50% removal (the documented eastern decline), mu_scale=0.5 -> 90% CI roughly [31%, 69%].
disease_prior._field_comment: sev_field_budget is the total regional deviation the severity field may add on the logit scale (distributed as budget/sqrt(n) per coefficient); 0.5 comfortably reaches west ~25-30% vs east ~60%. lag0_scale/lag_field_budget are YEARS of onset-timing slack, continental and regional respectively -- the arrival map is a hand-built smoothed reconstruction, so its timing is coarse both overall and regionally.
disease_prior._late_comment: Severity coefficient on centered arrival year, per DECADE. Negative means populations reached later were hit less hard (the western-genetic-diversity hypothesis). One coefficient encodes the mechanism directly instead of spending spatial-field capacity on what is essentially the arrival gradient.
disease_prior._recovery_comment: Slowly increasing resilience after local arrival: the hit decays toward severity*(1-recovery_fraction) with an e-folding time of recovery_tau years. recovery_logit_loc=-0.5 -> prior median ~38% of the hit eventually recovered, spanning 0 to ~90%.

map._comment: Continuation begins under tight priors and progressively relaxes them at absolute optimizer steps. The standard/full run uses 300 tight + 300 intermediate + 1200 nominal-prior steps (1800 total). Boundaries are independent of TOTAL_STEPS so extending/resuming a run cannot move backward. lr_decay_steps is likewise fixed across extensions; after step 900 optimization continues at the schedule's minimum learning rate.
map._log_every_comment: Steps between '[map] step ...' progress lines on stdout (the SLURM .o log). tqdm also carries the loss, but it writes a single carriage-return-rewritten line to stderr, so a running fit's loss trajectory is otherwise invisible in the log. Override per-run with HOUFIN_MAP_LOG_EVERY; 0 disables. A profile may set its own value.

quick90._comment: Fresh 90-minute development fit matching the successful accidental extension: 100 tight, 150 intermediate, and 650 nominal-prior steps (900 total). The learning-rate decay reaches its minimum at step 500 and stays there for the final 400 steps. This changes optimization only, not the final MAP objective.

runtime._comment: Production JAX jobs require a GPU and explicitly place model inputs in VRAM. HOUFIN_MODEL_INPUT_RESIDENCY=host is experimental: lax.scan is not a true differentiable host-streaming mechanism. SLURM wrappers record nvidia-smi VRAM/utilization plus host MemAvailable/SwapFree every 30 seconds.

run_names._comment: run_9: first fit with the STRUCTURED disease effect on K (severity x onset x recovery, bounded multiplicative) replacing the generic 967-coefficient spatiotemporal field that annihilated eastern carrying capacity. Also latent_dim 24. Not resume-compatible with run_8: st_weights/disease_mu/disease_lag are gone and eight new disease sites replace them.
